The '''E-56 repeating cannon''' was a type of personal [[Repeating blaster cannon/Legends|repeating blaster cannon]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
